# Left <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

</div>


```blitzbasic
Left:String string:String, count:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text. |
| `count` | In | Int32 | required | How many characters to take. |

**Returns:** The first `count` characters.

## Description

Returns the first characters of a string. Asking for more characters than there are returns the whole string.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Left$("hello", 2)
Print Left$("hello", 10)
```

```text
he
hello
```
